author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Eighty-Nine! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Former Games Workshop designer Sam Pearson (Warcry, Spearhead) has put out a free-to-play reimagining of classic Ruined City Skirmish with a modern design sensibility. Let's check it out!

Check out the the game and rosters for FREE HERE: https://www.blackdeathcity.com/
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 089 - Black Death City by Sam Pearson
